2607.22999.title: WCM: World-Cognition Model for Generalizable Human-Robot Interaction
2607.22999.paper_summary: Language agents can now interact fluently with users in software, but robots still struggle to bring comparable interaction to physical tasks. Current robot-control paradigms, including vision-language-action policies and world-model-based planners, are mainly optimized for instruction execution, leaving users with little visibility into why an action is chosen and few mechanisms to redirect, correct, or teach the robot through interaction. To solve this problem, we present the World-Cognition Model (WCM), a human-centered embodied agent built on the SLAK architecture (Sensing, Logic, Action, and Knowledge) and an asynchronous runtime. SLAK separates perception, reasoning, control, and memory, while the runtime allows reasoning, dialogue, and execution to proceed concurrently. WCM further introduces a human-in-the-loop teaching mode that enables users to interactively teach the robot difficult or long-horizon tasks. Teaching episodes and autonomous task rollouts are refined into chain-of-thought supervision to continually improve the model. WCM achieves a 73.8% average success rate across nine real-world human-robot interaction tasks, including tasks held out from CoT fine-tuning and a long-horizon task learned through teaching.
2607.22999.paper_summary_zh: 語言代理現在可以在軟體中與使用者流暢互動，但機器人在執行物理任務時仍然面臨挑戰。當前的機器人控制範式，包括視覺-語言-行動政策和基於世界模型的規劃器，主要針對指令執行進行優化，這使得使用者對於為何選擇某個行動的原因幾乎無法了解，且幾乎沒有機制可以通過互動來重新導向、修正或教導機器人。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了世界認知模型（WCM），這是一個以人為中心的具身代理，基於SLAK架構（感知、邏輯、行動和知識）和非同步運行時。SLAK將感知、推理、控制和記憶分開，而運行時則允許推理、對話和執行同時進行。WCM進一步引入了一種人類參與的教學模式，使使用者能夠互動式地教導機器人處理困難或長期的任務。教學過程和自主任務的展開被精煉成思維鏈監督，以不斷改進模型。WCM在九個現實世界的人機互動任務中實現了73.8%的平均成功率，包括從CoT微調中保留的任務和通過教學學習的長期任務。
2607.22999.author: Yuzhen Chen et.al.
